table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	itemname= item.name,   
	aliasname=item.customicode,   
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	address = dbo.customer.address1,
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,   
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,   
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	amt = CASE WHEN dbo.saleledger.SaleCatCode = 2 THEN dbo.saleledger.amt else dbo.saleledger.invtotal end, 
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	looseqty = sum(saledetail.looseqty),
	bonusqty = sum(saledetail.bonusqty),
	packqty = sum(saledetail.packqty),
	packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = saledetail.discperc,   
	salestax = saledetail.salestax,   
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,  
	posted=saleledger.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	balance=0,
	custcode=dbo.accounts.acccode,
	customeraliasname=dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	dbo.saleledger.SaleCatCode,
	customer.licenceno,
	salesperson = ( select name from salesman where dbo.salesman.salesmancode = dbo.saleledger.smancode)

FROM 
	saleledger, saledetail, accounts, customer, users, item
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_Code ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)
GROUP BY
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.headerno,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	dbo.saleledger.SaleCatCode,
	dbo.saleledger.invtotal,
	dbo.saleledger.posted,   
	dbo.saleledger.smancode,
	dbo.saleledger.amt,
	dbo.accounts.name,   
	dbo.accounts.acccode,
	dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	dbo.customer.address1,
	dbo.customer.address2,   
	dbo.customer.salestaxregno,
	dbo.customer.licenceno,
	dbo.users.username,   
	saledetail.gcode,   
	saledetail.icode,   
	saledetail.packunits,   
	saledetail.saleprice,   
	saledetail.discperc,   
	saledetail.salestax,   
	saledetail.itemflatdisc,  
	saledetail.unitsalestax,   
	saledetail.gstperc,   
	item.name,   
	item.customicode,   
	item.packingdesc
ORDER BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	dbo.item.name

objects.name: t_11
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)>0, 1, 0)

objects.name: compute_21
objects.visible: 1	if(sum( round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1 )=0, 0, 1)
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1 )

objects.name: compute_20
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 1 )

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.visible: 1	if(Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0) = 0, 0, 1)
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: compute_11
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: compute_12
objects.expression: ABS(Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0) + balance - amt)

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: if( Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0) + balance - amt < 0, 'Cr','' )
